en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 stays; Saudel 310 km east at 1pm
en.dek: Tropical Storm Saudel was centred about 310 kilometres east of Hong Kong at 1pm and is forecast to move northeast at about 10 km/h across the northeastern South China Sea.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Standby Signal No. 1 remains in force. At 1pm Tropical Storm Saudel was estimated to be about 310 kilometres east of Hong Kong (near 22.1 degrees north, 117.2 degrees east) and is forecast to move northeast at about 10 kilometres per hour across the northeastern part of the South China Sea.

Under the combined effect of Saudel and the northeast monsoon, local winds are occasionally strong offshore and on high ground. The Observatory said the signal is expected to remain in force for the rest of Wednesday.

According to the present forecast, Saudel will linger over the northeastern South China Sea tonight into Thursday before a higher chance of turning westwards, skirting the eastern Guangdong coast and edging closer to the Pearl River Estuary around Friday to Saturday. The Observatory will assess the need for the Strong Wind Signal No. 3 when it nears the estuary. Members of the public should continue to monitor the latest weather information.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號維持 沙德爾下午1時位於本港以東約310公里
zh.dek: 熱帶風暴沙德爾下午1時位於本港以東約310公里，預料向東北移動，時速約10公里，橫過南海東北部。
body: 香港天文台表示，一號戒備信號繼續生效。下午1時，熱帶風暴沙德爾集結在本港以東約310公里（北緯22.1度、東經117.2度附近），預料向東北移動，時速約10公里，橫過南海東北部。
受沙德爾與東北季候風共同影響，本港離岸及高地間中吹強風。天文台指信號預料在今日餘下時間維持。
按照現時預測，沙德爾今晚至周四初時會在南海東北部徘徊，其後有較大機會轉偏西移動，掠過廣東東部沿岸，並在周五至周六左右再靠近珠江口一帶。天文台會密切監察其動向，評估接近珠江口時是否需要改發三號強風信號。市民請繼續留意最新天氣消息。
